name: lodash-bindall-no-names-miaow
behavioral_change: lodash 4.0.0 removed the v_old behavior of `_.bindAll` binding all enumerable function properties (own and inherited) when no method names are given. In v_new, `_.bindAll(obj)` with no method names binds nothing; the function name and signature are unchanged.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (miaow) calls `_.bindAll(this)` in the constructors of `Compilation` and `Compiler` and then passes methods such as `getFiles` as bare functions to `async.waterfall`; after the upgrade `this` is not the instance and the build throws `Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'concat' of undefined` in a `before all` hook. The stack frames point at eight later call sites in `lib/Compilation.js`, `lib/Compiler.js` and `lib/plugins/Cache.js`, none of which is the constructor line that must change, and the output never mentions lodash or `bindAll`.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes the two `_.bindAll(this)` calls (`lib/Compilation.js:15`, `lib/Compiler.js:13`) to `_.bindAll(this, _.functionsIn(this))`.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog), section Compatibility Warnings, states that support for binding all methods by default was removed from `_.bindAll`. Tier 2: the entry has no code; the new form is derived by comparing the v3 `_.bindAll` jsdoc with the v4 `_.functionsIn` jsdoc.
failing_tests: test :: "before all" hook (the exception is thrown in the before-all hook, so the whole suite does not run; none of the 5 tests of STATE-OLD runs in STATE-NEW)
